articles.summary: Franklin Financial Services Corporation (the Corporation) (NASDAQ: FRAF), the bank holding company of FM Trust (the Bank) headquartered in Chambersburg, PA, reported its third quarter and year-to-date 2026 financial results. A summary of notable operating results as of or for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 follows: Net Income: $8.5 million (basic earnings per share $1.90 and diluted earnings per share $1.89) for the third quarter of 2026 compared to $5.4 million (basic earnings per share $1.20 and diluted earnings per share $1.19) for the third quarter of 2025, an increase of 59.4%. Wealth Management: Fees were $2.4 million, an increase of 7.1% from $2.3 million in the third quarter of 2025. Assets under management were $1.471 billion on September 30, 2026. Asset Growth: $2.365 billion in assets on September 30, 2026, compared to $2.239 billion at year-end 2025, an increase of 5.6% (7.5% annualized). Loan Growth: Total net loans
articles.title: Franklin Financial Reports Third Quarter and Year-to-Date 2026 Results; Declares Dividend
